mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( receiver_id, type, title, message, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
